bullets_en: Attacks on police won't be tolerated: Telangana DGP CV Anand warns criminals.
'Number 850 represents murder of democracy': Rahul attacks BJP over delimitation.
30 killed as Myanmar military bombs school during religious ceremony.
NIA launches probe into Myanmar-based armed groups' terror links in Manipur.
TVK takes dig at Stalin over DMK’s support for delimitation bill with morphed image.
bullets_ur: Police par hamlay bardasht nahi kiye jayenge: Telangana ke DGP CV Anand ki mujrimon ko intebah.

Mazhabi taqreeb ke douran Myanmar fauj ki school par bombari se 30 afraad halaq.
NIA ne Manipur mein Myanmar ki hathyarband tanzimeon ke dehshatgardi se taaluqdat ki jaanch shuru kar di.
